title: interlock ledger entry
description: One line of .interlock/ledger.jsonl. The file is JSON Lines: one object per line, appended, never rewritten.

seq.description: Position in the file. Gaps mean lines were removed.

event.description: auto/hold/refuse are gate verdicts. cleared/rejected are human decisions. reuse means a past clearance covered this run. observed is shadow mode.

of.description: On cleared/rejected: the id of the hold being resolved.

warrant.description: On reuse: the id of the clearance being reused.

fingerprint.description: Hash of the failure class plus its normalised evidence. The same break always produces the same value.

reason.description: Why this verdict, in words a person can argue with.

by.description: Who signed off. Required on cleared and rejected.

rules.description: Hash of the enforcing parts of the policy at the moment of the decision. A clearance only carries while this matches.
